body_lead: Karnataka approves setting up of AI Centre of Excellence Priyank Kharge, Minister for Electronics, IT, Biotechnology and Science & Technology, said, “This is Karnataka’s deep tech decade, and the CATS AI Centre of Excellence will be a launchpad for deep-tech start-ups and industry collaborations."
